claim.statement: The Raft council starts on the first node, grows to at most seven voters, replaces a lost minority automatically (promoting a caught-up node), and hands over leadership before a voter with a 95 percent full disk is replaced; losing a majority stops writes and scheduling but not running apps.

sources.quote: and grows as nodes join, up to seven voters.
The council heals itself: lose a voter and the reconciler promotes a caught-up
There's no quorum, so nothing can be elected, scheduled or written; apps keep running.

claim.measurable: On 3 nodes stop one council voter - relish council status shows quorum ok (2/3 or replaced) without operator action and apps keep serving. Stop two - no applies commit (writes fail), existing apps and ingress keep serving. Two-voter councils cannot roll an upgrade. Election target under 5 s and full operability under 20 s are listed as unmeasured targets.
